The annual security report includes campus crime and fire statistics for the previous three years, information about how to report crimes and seek help, and details about how USU is preventing sexual violence and improving campus safety. All USU statewide campuses are included in the report available for download below. USU Annual Security and Fire Safety Report A printed copy of the annual security report is available upon request. Sustainability USU is committed to environmental prosperity, societal wellbeing, and economic balance in all places, for all people, across generations. Through innovative, resource-saving campus operations and researchers studying solutions to the 21st century’s greatest challenges, USU students, staff, and faculty sustain Utah. USU has received a Sustainability Tracking, Assessment & Rating System (STARS) Silver rating four consecutive times, in 2013, 2016, 2019, and 2022. Aggie Blue Bikes rents over 300 free bike rentals contribute Bicycle Friendly University Silver status. 10 mechanics at the shop teach 100s of students the fundamentals of bike maintenance each year, offering low-cost supplies and free tool boards. Tree Campus USA has recognized Utah State University since 2011, and the Logan campus became a certified arboretum in 2024. Our energy management teams have reduced building energy usage by almost 30% per square foot since 2007. All new buildings are Leadership in Energy & Environmental Design (LEED) certified, including two platinum-rated buildings, Wetland Discovery Point and Swaner EcoCenter. We hit 22 LEED certified buildings in 2024. Almost 70% of USU departments are engaged in sustainability research.
